name: Dumbbell Decline Fly
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline, secure your legs under the pads, and lie back.
Hold two dumbbells above your lower chest with palms facing each other and elbows softly bent.
Open your arms out in a wide arc until you feel a comfortable stretch across your chest.
Sweep both dumbbells back together above your chest along the same arc.
tips: Stop the descent before your shoulders roll forward off the pad.
Keep a steady slight bend in your elbows so the move stays a fly rather than a press.
